research_scope: Source-free context-complete mathematical equivalence review of common prerequisites; original candidate identities and the source wording are retained.

aliases.reason: Both flatness and faithful flatness sources involve precisely the covariant tensoring functor N↦N⊗_R M on R-modules and its action on morphisms. Faithfulness/reflection of exactness adds a distinct defining condition but does not change the tensor functor.

The ordered-set Dedekind completeness and complete-ordered-real-field sources invoke the same least-upper-bound notion: an upper bound of a subset A no larger than any other upper bound. The order/field axioms remain separately required.

The finite prime field and Cohen ring sources both use a positive prime integer p whose only positive divisors are 1 and p. Mapping p to p·1_R is extra ambient ring interpretation, not a different concept of primality.
The positive characteristic of a field and the finite prime field source both require an ordinary integer prime p>1. Neither occurrence denotes a prime ideal or prime element of an arbitrary ring.

The real power-series and real ordinary generating-function sources use the same arbitrary sequence of real coefficients indexed by nonnegative integers. Convergence of the associated series is an additional property of the generating-function source.
